Subject: Interested in Redwood — demo request

Hi Jasmine,

I signed up for Redwood via the self-serve flow yesterday and am interested in a product demo to evaluate for our use case. A little about us: we’re HealthTech, a clinical workflow company focusing on automated clinical summarization for care teams.

A few quick details:
- Use case: clinical note summarization + PHI-aware redaction
- Expected volume: ~50k requests/day (will scale to 75k peak)
- Avg tokens per request: ~700–900 (varies by note length)
- Timeline: aiming for a POC in Q4 and production by end of Q1

We’d like to see: deployment options (hosted vs private), latency/cost tradeoffs, and security controls (SOC2, audit logs, KMS). I attached the signup export in case that helps.

Are you available for a 30-min demo next week? Preferred times: Tue/Wed mornings PT.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of Product, HealthTech
priya.shah@healthtech.com

Hi Priya — thanks for signing up and for the context, this is helpful. I’m Jasmine on Redwood’s SDR team — happy to get a demo on the calendar and make sure we tailor it to your needs. A couple quick qualification questions so we have the right folks on the call: 

1) Are you evaluating hosted Redwood API first, or do you need a Private (VPC/on-prem) deployment during the POC?
2) For the POC, do you care about throughput more (tokens/sec) or latency per request?
3) Any specific compliance requirements beyond SOC 2 (e.g., HIPAA BAAs)?
4) Who else from your team should join the demo (engineering/infosec/product)?

I can run the demo with one of our Solutions Engineers (cc’d: Marissa Cole). I’m free Tue/Wed 9–11am PT next week — feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/jasmine-30min. I’ve attached a short demo agenda so you know what to expect.
